$comment: Waycar brand tokens: the one source for colors, gradients, type, radii, spacing, glass, and shadows. Edit this file, then run scripts/generate-brand-tokens.py. Read DESIGN.md before adding a token.

bg.note: Page ground. Near-black, never pure black.

panel.note: Inset panels and badges that sit on the ground.

ink.note: Deepest near-black. Terminal window ground, and text on paper.

surface.note: Form fields and the core of device bezels.

surface-3.note: Composer and other raised input panels.

paper.note: The one light surface: primary button, skip link, QR ground.

white.note: Neutral base for white hairlines, sheen, and tints. Use with alpha.

black.note: Neutral base for drop shadows. Use with alpha.

line-2.note: Stronger hairline: buttons, windows, device frames.

text-2.note: Secondary text and ledes. 8.2:1 on bg.

text-3.note: Tertiary text, captions, muted title words. 5.3:1 on bg (AA).

title-fade.note: Bottom of the hero headline fade.

violet-soft.note: Readable violet for text on dark: kickers, prompts, selection.

accent.note: Interactive tint in the app (AccentColor): buttons, links, selection, toggles, the New Agent button. Light mode uses the light value. The site stays violet through `violet`/`violet-soft`.

indigo.note: Middle stop of the brand gradient only.

quiet-action.note: Cancel and dismiss buttons in alerts, dialogs, sheets and menus: quiet gray, so the primary violet and destructive red stand out. App-only; the site has no quiet controls.

cyan.note: Brand cyan. Focus rings, live dots, links in code.

cyan-deep.note: Cyan that reads on paper (the dot inside the primary button).

blocked.note: Agent status: blocked. Matches herdr's TUI palette.

danger.note: Errors, strike-throughs, and the red usage tier.

warn.note: Warnings and the amber usage glow.

term-accent.note: Terminal highlights such as package names.

mark-ground.note: App icon ground, sampled like every mark color from docs/images/waycar-icon.svg (scripts/generate-app-icons.py, violet palette). Only on surfaces that echo the icon.

mark-surface.note: App icon track color, for cards on mark-ground.

mark-accent.note: App icon body color. Badges and buttons on mark-ground; content on it is mark-ground, as the icon cuts its prompt through to the ground.

mark-highlight.note: App icon cupola window. Small symbols on mark-ground.

chat-user.note: Chat Mode: the user's message bubble and the Console's Chat Mode badge. Violet family, deep enough for text on it.

chat-user-text.note: Chat Mode: text on the user bubble, and the badge's glyph.

chat-agent.note: Chat Mode: the Agent's message bubble, typing indicator, and Blocked card. Raised-surface family.

blue.note: herdr's Catppuccin blue, the hue its sidebar paints the rows waiting on the user. The Latte ink keeps OKLCH H and C and drops L until badge text clears 4.5:1 on its 0.15-opacity wash.

green.note: herdr's Catppuccin green. Latte ink darkened the same way as blue.

yellow.note: herdr's Catppuccin yellow. Latte yellow measures 2.3:1 on its own capsule, so its ink is darkened the same way as blue.

red.note: herdr's Catppuccin red, for herdr's unknown status: something failed. Latte ink darkened the same way as blue.

muted.note: herdr's muted-text role, for Idle and any status this build cannot read. Wash is Mocha overlay1 and Latte subtext0 (Mocha overlay0 is too dim for a phone label); ink is Mocha subtext0 and Latte subtext1.

grad.note: The brand gradient, violet to cyan. Accent words, kicker rules, toggles, tags.

grad-title.note: Hero headline fill, white fading to cool grey.

bezel-phone.note: iPhone frame around the hero screenshot.

bezel-phone-flat.note: iPhone frame in the screenshot gallery.

shadow-button.note: Primary button: white ring plus violet lift.

shadow-window.note: Terminal windows: deep drop plus a violet underglow.

glass.note: The glass card: faint white fill, hairline border, top sheen, 18 px corners. The site's default container.

gutter.note: Side padding. Compact below the compact breakpoint.

section-pad.note: Vertical padding of a page section.

sans.note: San Francisco on Apple devices, Geist elsewhere.

mono.note: Geist Mono on the web, SF Mono in the app. Every label, kicker, pill, and code sample.

lede.note: Intro paragraph under a title, in text-2.

label.note: Kickers above titles. Uppercase, spaced out, violet-soft.
